10: import fs from 'fs-extra';

14:   posixPath,

23: import {assetRequireAttributeValue} from '../utils';
24: // @ts-expect-error: TODO see https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49721
25: import type {Transformer} from 'unified';
26: // @ts-expect-error: TODO see https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49721
27: import type {MdxJsxTextElement} from 'mdast-util-mdx';
28: import type {Image} from 'mdast';
29: import type {Parent} from 'unist';
30: 
31: const {
32:   loaders: {inlineMarkdownImageFileLoader},
33: } = getFileLoaderUtils();
34: 
35: type PluginOptions = {
36:   staticDirs: string[];
37:   siteDir: string;
38: };
39: 
40: type Context = PluginOptions & {
41:   filePath: string;
42: };

44: type Target = [node: Image, index: number, parent: Parent];

46: async function toImageRequireNode(
47:   [node]: Target,
48:   imagePath: string,
49:   filePath: string,
50: ) {
51:   // MdxJsxTextElement => see https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/pull/8288#discussion_r1125871405
52:   const jsxNode = node as unknown as MdxJsxTextElement;
53:   const attributes: MdxJsxTextElement['attributes'] = [];
54: 
55:   let relativeImagePath = posixPath(
56:     path.relative(path.dirname(filePath), imagePath),
57:   );
58:   relativeImagePath = `./${relativeImagePath}`;
59: 
60:   const parsedUrl = url.parse(node.url);
61:   const hash = parsedUrl.hash ?? '';
62:   const search = parsedUrl.search ?? '';
63:   const requireString = `${inlineMarkdownImageFileLoader}${
64:     escapePath(relativeImagePath) + search
65:   }`;
66:   if (node.alt) {
67:     attributes.push({
68:       type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
69:       name: 'alt',
70:       value: escapeHtml(node.alt),
71:     });
72:   }
73: 
74:   attributes.push({
75:     type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
76:     name: 'src',
77:     value: assetRequireAttributeValue(requireString, hash),
78:   });
79: 
80:   if (node.title) {
81:     attributes.push({
82:       type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
83:       name: 'title',
84:       value: escapeHtml(node.title),
85:     });
86:   }
87: 
88:   try {
89:     const size = (await promisify(sizeOf)(imagePath))!;
90:     if (size.width) {
91:       attributes.push({
92:         type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
93:         name: 'width',
94:         value: String(size.width),
95:       });
96:     }
97:     if (size.height) {
98:       attributes.push({
99:         type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
100:         name: 'height',
101:         value: String(size.height),
102:       });
103:     }
104:   } catch (err) {
105:     // Workaround for https://github.com/yarnpkg/berry/pull/3889#issuecomment-1034469784
106:     // TODO remove this check once fixed in Yarn PnP
107:     if (!process.versions.pnp) {
108:       logger.warn`The image at path=${imagePath} can't be read correctly. Please ensure it's a valid image.
109: ${(err as Error).message}`;
110:     }
111:   }
112: 
113:   Object.keys(jsxNode).forEach(
114:     (key) => delete jsxNode[key as keyof typeof jsxNode],
115:   );
116: 
117:   jsxNode.type = 'mdxJsxTextElement';

124:   const imageExists = await fs.pathExists(imagePath);
125:   if (!imageExists) {
126:     throw new Error(

129:       )} used in ${toMessageRelativeFilePath(sourceFilePath)} not found.`,

136:   {siteDir, filePath, staticDirs}: Context,
137: ) {
138:   if (imagePath.startsWith('@site/')) {
139:     const imageFilePath = path.join(siteDir, imagePath.replace('@site/', ''));
140:     await ensureImageFileExist(imageFilePath, filePath);
141:     return imageFilePath;

144:     const possiblePaths = staticDirs.map((dir) => path.join(dir, imagePath));

147:       fs.pathExists,
148:     );
149:     if (!imageFilePath) {
150:       throw new Error(
151:         `Image ${possiblePaths
152:           .map((p) => toMessageRelativeFilePath(p))
153:           .join(' or ')} used in ${toMessageRelativeFilePath(
154:           filePath,
155:         )} not found.`,
156:       );
157:     }
158:     return imageFilePath;
159:   }

163:     decodeURIComponent(imagePath),
164:   );
165:   await ensureImageFileExist(imageFilePath, filePath);
166:   return imageFilePath;
167: }

169: async function processImageNode(target: Target, context: Context) {
170:   const [node] = target;
171:   if (!node.url) {
172:     throw new Error(
173:       `Markdown image URL is mandatory in "${toMessageRelativeFilePath(
174:         context.filePath,
175:       )}" file`,
176:     );
177:   }

179:   const parsedUrl = url.parse(node.url);
180:   if (parsedUrl.protocol || !parsedUrl.pathname) {
181:     // pathname:// is an escape hatch, in case user does not want her images to
182:     // be converted to require calls going through webpack loader
183:     if (parsedUrl.protocol === 'pathname:') {
184:       node.url = node.url.replace('pathname://', '');
185:     }
186:     return;
187:   }

189:   // We try to convert image urls without protocol to images with require calls
190:   // going through webpack ensures that image assets exist at build time
191:   const imagePath = await getImageAbsolutePath(parsedUrl.pathname, context);
192:   await toImageRequireNode(target, imagePath, context.filePath);
193: }

196:   return async (root, vfile) => {
197:     const promises: Promise<void>[] = [];
198:     visit(root, 'image', (node: Image, index, parent) => {

201:           ...options,
202:           filePath: vfile.path!,
203:         }),
204:       );
205:     });
206:     await Promise.all(promises);
207:   };

part.text:
Fixed the relative asset path bug in `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts:238`.

The Markdown link regex now:
- Requires `.md`/`.mdx` to be the actual final extension, so directories like `file.md__static_image_assets__` are not mistaken for links.
- Allows whitespace around link destinations.
- Ignores protocol/`@site` links wrapped in angle brackets.
- Preserves query strings, hashes, and link titles.

Validated with the Markdown link tests (14 passed) and image/link transform tests (10 passed), plus a direct check of the reported `file.md__static_image_assets__` case.
